This update was also given the name '''Lunar Overture Update''', as it added the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. This version encompassed fifteen updates, the main v1.9.0 update (released 28 October 2023) and fourteen minor updates, the v1.9.0a (released 28 October 2023), the v1.9.0b (released 28 October 2023),
